provenance.grid_line_text: GRID <- as.matrix(subset(expand.grid(form = 0:20, trend = 0:20, resid = 0:20, elo = 0:20), form + trend + resid + elo == 20)) / 20
provenance.rule: GRID rows are form, trend, resid, elo = 0..20 with form + trend + resid + elo == 20, divided by 20, so every weighting sums to 1; NBA_W fixes form = 0.7, trend = 0.1, resid = 0.1 and elo takes the rest.
provenance.note: Not in either results file (owner decision, #226): read from the study script at the study commit.

offseason_methods.reset: windows start fresh each season; fewer than k games that season = no value
offseason_methods.mean_regress: carried games pulled toward their season's league average: value -> avg + 0.50^(seasons back) x (value - avg)
offseason_methods.decay: carried games keep their value with weight 0.50^(seasons back) in the window mean; current-season games weigh 1
offseason_methods.season_to_date: mean of earlier games this season; under mean_regress/decay the first game uses the previous season (regressed / equal weights)

meta.opponent_adjustment: game value minus the opponent's mean over its earlier games this season (its whole previous season before its first game)
meta.elo: production walk-forward (tools/elo_model.R, ELO_K_FACTOR), every completed game from 2002, pregame ratings; expected margin = (Elo - opp Elo + 48 x home sign) / 25

stronger_arm.selection_rule: shortest window (1..17, season-to-date treated as longest) whose point score lies inside the 95% team-season block bootstrap interval of the best window's score

weights.standardisation: z-score across teams within each season-week (at least 10 teams)
weights.score: pooled held-out (LOSO) R^2 of margin beyond Elo from a one-variable linear map of the combined score fitted on training seasons

flags.note: SIMULATED detection rates: a methods check, not published data

one_score.label: One-score record vs expected
one_score.test: binomial z: wins in one-score games (|margin| <= 8, ties half) vs 0.5

pythagorean.label: Pythagorean vs actual
pythagorean.test: binomial z: wins vs the Pythagorean expectation (exponent 2.37; tested at p0 = 0.5)
pythagorean.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season win share - Pythagorean share|

fumble_recovery.label: Fumble-recovery rate
fumble_recovery.test: binomial z: share of all fumbles in the team's games recovered by the team vs 0.5

opp_fg_pct.label: Opponent field-goal %
opp_fg_pct.test: binomial z: opponents' field goals made vs the league rate (0.846)
opp_fg_pct.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season opponent FG% - league FG% that season|

turnover_margin.label: Turnover margin vs season level
turnover_margin.test: Poisson z: window takeaways minus giveaways vs the team's season level (variance 2 x league giveaways per game)
turnover_margin.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season turnover margin per game|

blowout_skew.label: Blowout skew
blowout_skew.test: binomial z: share of games decided by 17+ points vs the league rate (0.259)
blowout_skew.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season blowout share - league share|

opponent_strength.label: Opponent strength
opponent_strength.test: z: mean opponent pregame Elo vs the league mean that season, game-to-game SD within team-seasons
opponent_strength.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season mean opponent Elo - league mean|

rest_bye.label: Rest / bye share
rest_bye.test: z: mean rest-day difference (team minus opponent, within season) vs 0, game-to-game SD within team-seasons

key_players_missing.label: Key players missing
key_players_missing.test: binomial z: key player-games missed vs the league rate (0.093); key = the team-season's 22 players with most snaps
key_players_missing.effect_basis: 90th percentile of |team-season key player-games missed share - league share|
key_players_missing.caveat: player-games are not independent (one injury spans several games), so this test overstates detection

study.title: NFL momentum measures study: does team momentum predict the next game and the next 3 games beyond team strength (Elo)?

seasons.role: seed for the cross-season windows only

study.holdout: 2026 regular season to date: forward test, scored once in the final run after every choice was fixed (scored in this run: TRUE)
study.baseline: Team Elo after its latest game (pregame Elo for the next game) plus season-to-date point margin per game
protocol: Leave-one-season-out over 2012-2025 with pooled out-of-fold predictions
Paired bootstrap, 2000 resamples of whole team-seasons (next-3 targets overlap from game to game)
Baseline: Elo after the game plus season-to-date margin per game; candidates scored on what they add
Every feature uses only the team's earlier games; cross-team z-scores per date use each team's latest state on or before that date
No imputation; missing values are counted per feature
Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate across the 121 features per target (q < 0.05)
Nested combination search: top 6 series x top 6 measures ranked on training seasons only, 400 combinations x 3 ridge penalties chosen by inner leave-one-season-out
Permutation baseline: 200 reruns of the whole nested search with the target shuffled among teams within each date
Flags (QB change, bye, week 18) reported as their own rows; no row is dropped
Sensitivity runs: without 2020; windows spanning the previous season's last 6 games

seeds.bootstrap: STUDY_SEED + number of seasons in the run

targets.definition: Mean over the team's next 3 games of (point margin minus the margin Elo expected). The expectation is the opponent adjustment: it uses the team's Elo after game k, the opponent's pregame Elo and home field, (Elo - opp Elo + 48 x home sign) / 25 points (tools/elo_model.R constants).
Same for the team's next game only.

Next game won by the home team (one row per game; ties left out and counted), logistic model on the pregame Elo difference with home field plus the season-to-date margin-per-game difference; scored by log loss and ROC-AUC.

measures.name: ROC-3
measures.forward_only_definition: Elo: (Elo after game k - Elo before game k-2) / 3. Box series: mean of the last 3 values minus the mean of the team's values before them (at least 3 earlier values). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: MACD
measures.forward_only_definition: Exponentially weighted mean of the series with span 2 minus the same with span 6, updated game by game from the season's first value. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Velocity
measures.forward_only_definition: Slope of a least-squares line through the trailing 6 values of the series. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Acceleration
measures.forward_only_definition: Velocity after game k minus velocity 3 values earlier. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: EWMA of changes
measures.forward_only_definition: Exponentially weighted mean (span 2) of the per-game change (Elo) or surprise (box series: game value minus the team's own mean of its earlier values). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Z-score
measures.forward_only_definition: ROC-3 divided by the standard deviation of the team's changes or surprises in games 1..k (expanding window). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: RSI
measures.forward_only_definition: Over the last 6 changes or surprises: 100 x average gain / (average gain + average loss); recent gains vs losses on a 0-100 scale. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Growth difference
measures.forward_only_definition: Sum of the last 3 changes or surprises minus the sum of the 3 before them (a difference, because the ratio is unstable near zero). Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Kalman slope
measures.forward_only_definition: Filtered slope of a local linear trend model (level + slope + noise) run forward through games 1..k; its three noise variances are fitted by maximum likelihood on the training seasons only. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Streak
measures.forward_only_definition: Signed length of the current run: wins/losses for Elo, positive/negative surprises for the other series. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

measures.name: Impulse
measures.forward_only_definition: m[k] = 0.75 x m[k-1] + change or surprise in game k, from the season's first value. Uses only the team's games up to and including the latest one; no value before the team's 3rd value of the series that season.

series.name: Elo rating
series.definition: Production Elo rating after each game (tools/elo_model.R: K 28, home field 48 Elo points, margin-of-victory multiplier, 2/3 season carry-over; every completed game from 2002).

series.name: Point margin (opponent-adjusted)
series.definition: Point margin minus the opponent's season-to-date average margin allowed (earlier games only).

series.name: Offensive EPA/play
series.definition: Offensive EPA per play (all plays with an EPA, as epa_metrics_engine.R) minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Defensive EPA/play allowed
series.definition: Defensive EPA per play allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average produced; lower is better.

series.name: Offensive success rate
series.definition: Offensive success rate minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Defensive success rate allowed
series.definition: Defensive success rate allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average produced; lower is better.

series.name: Pass EPA/play (offense)
series.definition: EPA per pass play (pass == 1: dropbacks incl. sacks and scrambles) minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Rush EPA/play (offense)
series.definition: EPA per designed run (rush == 1) minus the opponent's season-to-date average allowed.

series.name: Pass EPA/play allowed
series.definition: EPA per pass play allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average produced; lower is better.

series.name: Rush EPA/play allowed
series.definition: EPA per designed run allowed minus the opponent's season-to-date average produced; lower is better.

series.name: Turnover margin
series.definition: Takeaways minus giveaways (interceptions plus fumbles lost) minus the opponent's season-to-date average turnover margin allowed.

limits: The NFL has no momentum board yet, so there are no blend weights to test; blend_weights is null.
Effects are small: regression to the mean dominates NFL results over 1-3 games, and the next-3 target is noisy.

The combination search uses rows where all 121 features exist (from about a team's 9th game, because acceleration needs 9 values of a series) so every candidate is scored on the same rows; single features use all rows where they exist.
Opponent-adjusted series have no value in a team's first game (the opponent has no earlier games that season), so their measures start one game later than Elo's.
Kalman variances are fitted on the outer training seasons and reused in the inner loop; the without-2020 sensitivity reuses the 14-season fold fits.
Bootstrap intervals for the incremental IC hold the ranks at their full-sample values.
The next-game win target is scored by log loss; its ROC-AUC change is a point estimate without an interval.
The week-18 flag exists only from 2021 (17-game seasons); a supplementary final-week flag covers week 17 in 2012-2020.
Elo gives the listed home team home field at every site, as tools/elo_model.R does; neutral-site games are not treated separately.
Franchises that moved (OAK/LV, SD/LAC, STL/LA) are keyed by today's abbreviation so their Elo carries over.
2026 is in progress (through week 11); it is a single small forward test.

board.selection: Rows of rolling_window.weights.detail with method = MOMENTUM_BOARD_CARRY_METHOD, window in MOMENTUM_BOARD_WINDOWS and target next_game (config.R); their best_weights were checked equal to MOMENTUM_BOARD_WEIGHTS when this file was published.
